standard.summary: 每 N 步才 VAE decode + 编码器
standard.whenToUse: 不确定时先保持默认，小步数短测后再调。
standard.avoidWhen: 与预检冲突或与其它互斥选项同时开启时。

standard_en.summary: Only VAE-decodes and runs the encoder every N steps
standard_en.whenToUse: When unsure keep the default; run a short low-step test before changing it.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When it conflicts with preflight, or when a mutually exclusive option is enabled at the same time.

advanced.principle: 每 N 步才 VAE decode + 编码器；中间步跳过 visual REPA（主 loss 仍训）。默认 4（16G 友好）；填 1=每步最真最贵。

advanced_en.principle: VAE decode + encoder run only every N steps; intermediate steps skip visual REPA (the main loss still trains). Default 4 (16G-friendly); 1 = every step, most faithful and most expensive.
